8202:
שָׁפָט _n.pr.m_. (**he hath judged**)
**1.** father of Elisha
**2.** prince of Simeon
**3.** grandson of Zerub.
**4.** Gaddite chief
**5.** herdsman of David
8203:
שְׁפַטְיָה(וּ) _n.pr.m_. (י׳ **hath judged**, **vindicated**)
**1.** יָה:
**a.** fifth son of David
**b.** contemp. of Jerem.
**c.** man of Judah
**d.** chiefs of families of restoration
**e.** Benjamite
**2.** יָהוּ:
**a.** son of Jehosh.
**b.** hero of David
**c.** Simeonite
8210:
שָׁפַךְ 113 _vb_. **pour out**, **pour**
**Qal**
**1.** lit.
**2.** fig.
**Niph**. **be poured out**
**Pu**. **be poured out**
**Hithp**. **my soul pours itself out upon me**
8213:
שָׁפֵל _vb_. **be** or **become low**, **be abased**
**Qal**
**1.** all Is: **become** (be brought, laid) **low**
**2.** **to be lowly of spirit**
**3.** of sound
**Hiph**.
**1.** usu. fig., **lay low**
**2.** hum. subj. **set** one **in a lower place**
**3.** as helping vb.: **make low**, **sit down** = take low seat
8217:
שָׁפָל _adj_. **low**
**1.** **low**, in height
**2.** of a modest, unambitious kingdom
**3.** **humiliated**
**4.** **lowly**, as subst.
8221: שְׁפָם _n.pr.loc_. on E. border of Israel
8227:
שָׁפָן _n.pr.m_.
**1.** secretary under Josiah
**2.** father of אֲחִיקָם, contemp. of 1 (improb. = 1)
**3.** father of אֶלְעָשָׂה, perh. = 2.
**4.** father of גְּמַרְיָ֫הוּ, perh. = 1.
**5.** father of יַאֲזַנְיָ֫הוּ, possibly = 1.
8237: [שׁפרור Kt, שַׁפְרִיר Qr] _n.[m.]_ doubtful; appar. of (**brightly-coloured** ?) royal **pavilion**, **canopy**, or poss. **carpet**, sf. [[24-jeremiah.43.10|Je 43:10]]
8240: שְׁפַתַּ֫יִם _n.[m.]du_. doubtful word: usu. **hook-shaped pegs**, **hooks**; abs. [[26-ezekiel.40.43|Ez 40:43]]

**Pu**. denom. v. infra.

**1.** **shew quietness** (inner causat.), of men
